QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_42

question.text: What must a DP do when opening a demat account for a PAN-exempt applicant?

answer.text: Collect documentary evidence of the exemption and capture the appropriate PAN exemption code
A declaration from a gazetted officer

explanation.text: The Logic: For PAN-exempt applicants (for example exempt U.N. entities or multilateral agencies), the DP must obtain documentary evidence supporting the exemption and record the appropriate PAN exemption code in the account. The Trap: 'No documentation' would be a compliance violation. Even PAN-exempt categories require documentary evidence and an exemption code. Note: Exemption handling is via SEBI-recognised exemption codes plus documentary evidence; the workbook does not, in the pages checked, frame this around PAN-Aadhaar invalidity or account freezing.
